title: Home Strength Program
split: Push / Pull / Legs (+ optional Full Body)

notes.structure: Three sessions a week — Push, Pull, Legs — on non-consecutive days (e.g. Mon/Wed/Fri). Day 4 (Full Body) is an optional extra for a 4th session.
notes.warmup: Do the warm-up block, then ramp up the first heavy lift; the second main lift gets 1–2 feeler sets, accessories none.
notes.progression: Add a little weight or one rep when the top of the rep range feels easy; keep pressing pain-free.
notes.rest: ~2–3 min on heavy lifts, 60–90 s on accessories, less on core.
notes.shoulderAndBack: Goblet squat and dumbbell RDL are the back/shoulder-sparing options; keep bench, overhead press, back squat and barbell RDL moderate and pain-free. Not medical advice — clear with a physio.

warmup.guidance: Do these in order — high knees to raise your heart rate, then the drills to prime the pattern. Ramp up your first heavy lift — e.g. empty bar ×8, ~60% ×5, ~80% ×3, ~90% ×1–2, then your working sets. The day’s second main lift gets 1–2 light feeler sets; accessories need none.
